# Karmatix Learn

> A hand-picked map of what to learn, where to practise and who to learn with, for software developers, with a focus on India. Free, no sign-up, no affiliate links.

Karmatix Learn does not teach topics itself. It recommends the best existing courses, practice platforms, certifications, YouTube channels, tools and developer communities, arranged into step-by-step paths, and says how to use each one.

## Paths

- [Frontend developer](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/frontend/): Build fast, accessible interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. 4 stages, about 6 to 9 months part time.
- [Backend developer](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/backend/): Design APIs, model data and run services that stay up. 4 stages, about 8 to 12 months part time.
- [Mobile app developer](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/mobile/): Build apps people install, from first screen to Play Store release. 4 stages, about 6 to 9 months part time.
- [Cloud and DevOps engineer](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/cloud/): Run software reliably on the cloud with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and IaC. 4 stages, about 8 to 12 months part time.
- [AI engineer](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/ai/): Build useful products with machine learning and large language models. 4 stages, about 9 to 12 months part time.
- [Data analyst](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/data/): Turn messy data into decisions with SQL, spreadsheets, Python and dashboards. 4 stages, about 4 to 6 months part time.
- [Placements and DSA](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/dsa/): Crack online assessments and coding interviews with patterns, not memorising. 4 stages, about 3 to 6 months part time.
- [Cybersecurity](https://learn.karmatix.in/paths/security/): Learn how systems are attacked so you can defend them. 4 stages, about 9 to 12 months part time.

## Key pages

- [All resources](https://learn.karmatix.in/resources/): 168 picks, filterable by type, path, cost and language.
- [Certifications compared](https://learn.karmatix.in/certifications/): 15 certifications with exam fees, validity and an honest verdict.
- [Connect with developers](https://learn.karmatix.in/connect/): meetups, online communities, open source programmes, hackathons and a networking playbook.

## Stack roadmaps

- [All stack roadmaps](https://learn.karmatix.in/roadmaps/): Flutter, .NET and C#, React and Next.js, Node.js, Python backend, Java and Spring Boot, Android with Kotlin, React Native and Go. Each lists every skill as a checklist, where to learn it, projects to build and interview topics.

## Free practice by Karmatix

- [Karmatix .NET Academy](https://karma-tic.github.io/dotnet-academy/): the .NET roadmap with 16 tested sample projects, interview prep and cheat sheets.
- [Karmatix Flutter Roadmap](https://karma-tic.github.io/flutter-course/): the Flutter roadmap with mock tests, a CRUD lab and cheat sheets.
